question: Which government body was responsible for implementing the Technology Mission on Oilseeds?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Agriculture**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Technology Mission on Oilseeds was launched by the Government of India in **1986** to boost oilseed production and reduce dependence on imports.
 
• The mission was spearheaded by the **Ministry of Agriculture**, which took responsibility for its implementation.
 
• The initiative aimed at improving oilseed productivity through better agricultural practices, high-yielding seed varieties, and enhanced market infrastructure.
 
• It was a part of the efforts to achieve **self-sufficiency in edible oil production** in India.
 
• The mission also focused on **research and development**, bringing together agricultural scientists and farmers to achieve targeted results.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Mission on Edible Oils – Oil Palm (NMEO-OP):**

 
 
• Launched in **2021**, this mission aims to boost oil palm cultivation and reduce India's dependency on edible oil imports.
 
• The scheme targets increasing domestic production of palm oil by providing financial assistance to farmers.
 
• It includes support for planting materials, expansion of farming areas, and research activities.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Oilseeds in India:**
 
 
• India is one of the largest consumers of edible oils globally, making oilseed cultivation vital for food security.
 
• Common oilseeds include soybean, groundnut, mustard, sunflower, and sesame.
 
• Oilseeds also contribute to industrial products like biodiesel and cosmetics.
 
 
 
• **Green Revolution:**
 
 
• Though primarily focused on cereals, the Green Revolution laid the foundation for improved agricultural practices, later adapted for oilseeds.
 
• It introduced high-yielding seed varieties and better irrigation methods to enhance productivity.
 
 
 
• **Self-sufficiency in Edible Oils:**
 
 
• Despite the Technology Mission on Oilseeds, India continues to rely heavily on imports for edible oils, particularly palm oil.
 
• Recent government initiatives aim to address this gap and promote sustainable production.
